english.note: Use this when someone proceeds boldly without holding back, especially before an action such as doing or saying something.

exampleSentences.english: Go ahead and boldly say what you think.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你放膽講出你嘅諗法啦。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 fong3 daam2 gong2 ceot1 nei5 ge3 nam2 faat3 laa1

english.note: Use this for speaking or acting freely without inhibition or fear, rather than merely without a rule or restriction.

exampleSentences.english: If you have any opinions, speak freely.
exampleSentences.jyutping: jau5 me1 ji3 gin3 zau6 fong3 daam2 gong2
